_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: Exists in id_registry as referenced_not_built. Registry shows phase_scope 'full' but research and brief position this as finish-only (Scenario B per FFD Section 5.2). Registry correction proposed to update phase_scope to 'finish'. Context prefix TRIM is shared with companion SF_TRIM_NC_PRIME — no collision because TSK_ IDs are action-specific (e.g., TSK_TRIM_BRUSH_FINISH vs TSK_TRIM_BRUSH_PRIME).

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. TSK_TRIM_* not in context_prefixes_in_use. Shared with companion SF_TRIM_NC_PRIME — distinct by action suffix (BRUSH_FINISH vs BRUSH_PRIME).
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_TRIM_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based (BRUSH_FINISH_1, SPRAY_FINISH_1, SAND_BETWEEN, INSPECT_COAT, FINAL_INSPECT, TOUCHUP)

expected_modules.description: Protection setup — floor drops, wall masking (spray or SS_PAINTED_* walls)
Light post-primer touch-up — inspect, light sand, touch-up caulk, dust cleanup
First finish coat application (brush or spray variant)
Between-coat inspect, sand, repair, dust cleanup — runs at ALL quality tiers
Second finish coat (brush or spray variant)

module_prefix.notes: Finish-only pattern (Scenario B per FFD Section 5.2). No primer module — handled by SF_TRIM_NC_PRIME. QT5 brush/roll may add additional FINISH_COAT + INTERSTAGE cycle (3+ coats per FFD 15.10.3).

paintscope_keys.description: Shadow box / picture frame molding linear footage
Trim joint LF for touch-up caulking in initial prep
paintscope_keys.notes: IN_LF_TRIM_EDGES is in id_registry entries_in_active_use. PS_EDGE_LF.TRIM_JOINTS needs addition to PS_ entries_in_active_use.

paintscope_keys.description: Wall masking LF at trim-to-wall edge (spray method, or any method when walls are SS_PAINTED_*)
paintscope_keys.notes: Broader scope than existing PS_PROTECT_LF.WALL_ADJACENT_DOOR. Covers wall masking along all trim types (baseboard, crown, chair rail, etc.), not just door casing. Both PS_ and IN_ need registry addition.

paintscope_keys.description: Count of fixtures (outlets/switches) near spray zone
paintscope_keys.notes: Required when application_method = spray. Both PS_ and IN_ need registry addition. May be derivable from room count heuristic.

sheen.notes: Sheen/QT gate: satin at QT3+, semi-gloss at QT4+, gloss at QT5 only. Default semi-gloss is incompatible with default QT3 — spec must enforce gate at runtime.

phase.notes: Finish-only spec — no 'prime' or 'apply' phase used. 'interstage' is between finish coats.

unit_of_measure.notes: LF is primary UOM for all trim items. SF for floor protection. EA/EA_ROOM/FIXED for discrete and per-room tasks.

substrate_state.notes: Output varies by sheen dimension. Input is always primed — this is a finish-only spec.

product_role.notes: Finish-only spec. No primer products (handled by SF_TRIM_NC_PRIME). No sealer products (edge sealing was prime spec scope).

surface_texture.notes: Trim surfaces are smooth (sanded, factory-primed). No texture variations.

modifier_mechanism.notes: QT3=baseline, QT4/QT5=selective_multiplier on qt_scaled tasks, QT5 brush/roll=additional_rounds (3+ coats).

floor_type.notes: Site condition affecting floor protection. Subfloor = no protection needed.

surface_ids.notes: All 9 trim surface_refs and all 3 adjacent surface_ids exist in id_registry. Multi-surface spec — primary_surface is trim_baseboard (most common), with 8 additional trim types.

existing_systems_to_consider.name: Gallery Series Full System
existing_systems_to_consider.notes: Architect-spec matched system — optional premium tier

material_system_prefix.notes: Reuse existing SYS_FF_ systems from SF_DOOR_FRAME_NC_FINISH. Same Fine Finish material tier progression applies to trim. Material systems are recommendations per QT — contractor discretion (RC-005).

proposed_for_this_spec.description: Standard 2-coat trim finish (QT3/QT4, or QT5 spray)
Extended 3-coat trim finish (QT5 brush/roll per FFD 15.10.3)
Trim finish coat coverage rate (~350-450 LF/gal)

cross_spec_coordination.notes: No cross-spec flags consumed or set. Masking off finished trim for wall painting is the WALL spec's responsibility (RC-007). Trim finish pairs naturally with SF_DOOR_FRAME_NC_FINISH for shared protection setup and material system.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup > prep > prime > apply > interstage > finish > cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: TSK_ prefix from resolution.json MUST be used in sop_modules and production
RULE 10: ITM_ IDs marked existing in resolution.json MUST use exact registered ID in spec.json
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values in resolution.json applicable_enums

registry_additions_proposed.name: Update phase_scope from 'full' to 'finish'
registry_additions_proposed.justification: SF_TRIM_NC_PAINT is a finish-only spec (Scenario B per FFD Section 5.2). Companion SF_TRIM_NC_PRIME handles primer phase. Registry currently shows phase_scope 'full' which is incorrect.

registry_additions_proposed.name: New Construction Trim Prime Coat
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Companion primer spec for SF_TRIM_NC_PAINT. Already referenced in ITM_ entries used_in arrays but missing from SF_ entries. phase_scope: prime, domain: interior.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Trim joint linear footage
registry_additions_proposed.justification: PS_ key for trim joints (touch-up caulking). Corresponding IN_LF_TRIM_EDGES already exists in IN_ entries. PS_ key needs addition to entries_in_active_use.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Wall masking LF at trim edge
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Broader scope than existing PS_PROTECT_LF.WALL_ADJACENT_DOOR — covers wall masking along all trim types (baseboard, crown, chair rail, etc.), not just door casing. Required when spraying or when walls are SS_PAINTED_*.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Wall adjacent LF for masking
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input for PS_PROTECT_LF.WALL_ADJACENT. No existing IN_ covers this scope (IN_LF_WALL_ADJACENT_DOOR is door-specific).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Fixture/outlet count near spray zone
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Count of fixtures (outlets/switches) requiring covers when spraying. Not currently in PS_ entries_in_active_use. May be derivable from room count heuristic.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Fixture count for protection
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input for PS_PROTECT_EA.ASSET.FIXTURES. No existing IN_ covers fixture/outlet counts.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Standard 2-coat trim finish sequence
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Standard coat sequence for trim finish at QT3/QT4 and QT5 spray. No existing ROUND_ covers trim-specific finish sequence.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Extended 3-coat trim finish (QT5 brush/roll)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Extended coat sequence for QT5 brush/roll per FFD 15.10.3. Adds additional finish coat + interstage cycle.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Trim finish coat coverage profile
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Coverage rate profile for trim finish coating (~350-450 LF/gal). No existing COV_ covers trim finish.
